n01.heard: Diamond Hands Mine, a quiet community built on a single rule, never sell the game.

n02.heard: On the night of the 14th, the mine led the grand final by a mile.  Then, with three seconds on the clock, somebody sold.

n09.heard: Then, a breakthrough, the match replay.

n10.heard: The replay showed nothing, but it was in black and white so it felt important.

n12.heard: And through it all, one alarm kept going off, nobody knew who's.

n13.heard: After 9 months, 40 detectives and one haunted shopping cart, the surrender was traced to a single account.  username the narrator.

n13b.heard: Yes, that was me. We were down around and I had a reservation.
